title: Lattice Model Splitting Independence
body_html:
Lattice Model Splitting Independence

Let \(A_1,A_2\) be self-dual lattices in \(W\), and let \(\omega_{A_i}\) be the section of the metaplectic cover defined by the lattice model \(S(A_i)\). Then \[ \omega_{A_1}(g)=\omega_{A_2}(g) \] for every \(g\) stabilizing both \(A_1\) and \(A_2\).
proof_html: The intertwining operator between the two lattice models is written by summing over the second lattice. Its uniqueness up to scalar and the fact that \(g\) preserves the Haar measure on the lattice imply that conjugating before or after the intertwiner gives the same operator.
